title: Graph Engineering approval request
description: The exact document a runtime emits when it needs a human authority transfer, and the frozen `data` payload of the HumanInputRequested event. A request binds one run, one graph revision, one node, one subject identity (an attempt or a durable decision), one canonical subject-document hash, and one requested scope. Binding all of them into the request identity is what stops a grant issued for one request from satisfying another. See approval-semantics.md.

apiVersion.description: Ownership discriminator. A document is a claimed approval request if and only if it carries this exact value.

requestId.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the domain-separated framing given in approval-semantics.md. It is recomputed on every presentation and is never trusted as carried.

subject.description: Exactly one attempt identity or one durable decision identity, plus the canonical hash of the exact document under approval. A barrier that resolved to 'human' produces subject.kind 'decision' whose decisionId is the frozen BarrierDecision identity and whose documentHash covers that document verbatim.

sideEffects.description: The value committed with NodeScheduled for the node under approval, echoed verbatim. 'none' is the only member that permits a grant without a confirmation block; the other three are in-doubt states in which a human must state what the external system actually did.

requestedScope.description: The authority being asked for. A grant may narrow it and may never widen it.

authorityHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the authority document in force when the request was emitted. A grant carrying a different value is authority drift, not forgery and not staleness.

leaseFence.description: The lease fencing token held when the request was emitted. A grant presented under a strictly greater live fence is stale, because another orchestrator has taken the run over.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters. It makes two otherwise identical requests distinct documents with distinct identities, so a grant for the first can never be replayed onto the second.

expiresAtMs.description: Strictly greater than requestedAtMs. Expiry is a refusal or an unknown, never a pass.

reason.description: Human-facing text. It carries no application value and is bounded; the redaction contract governs anything that would.

humanInputRequestedData.description: Frozen `data` payload of the HumanInputRequested event. It carries both the request and the exact document under approval, because the integrated barrier contract requires a 'human' resolution to emit HumanInputRequested carrying the decision document. request.subject.documentHash MUST equal the domain-separated canonical hash of `document`; the pair is otherwise unverifiable. spec/event.schema.json still declares an open `data` object; the integration lane owns referencing this definition from it, and this contract does not modify that file.

document.description: The exact document under approval, serialized verbatim. For a barrier that resolved to 'human' this is the frozen BarrierDecision document, unaltered.
